title: Trump calls Iran war 'effectively over' after talks with Qatar PM
detail: Al Jazeera reports Trump described the war as effectively over after meeting Qatar's prime minister, while saying the naval blockade and the newly announced land-route blockade ('Iron Gate') remain in effect.

media.caption: Trump calls Iran war 'effectively over' after talks with Qatar PM

title: Iran stands by demands to end the war as US ramps up military pressure
detail: Al Jazeera reports Tehran is holding to its seven demands, including lifting the US blockade and sanctions, as US strikes on Qeshm Island continue.

media.caption: Iran stands by demands to end the war as US ramps up military pressure

title: Rubio says war on Iran unpopular but 'necessary' to stop nuclear threat
detail: Al Jazeera reports Rubio said talks are not at the verge of a breakthrough and called Iran's demands unacceptable and in some cases outrageous.

media.caption: Rubio says war on Iran unpopular but 'necessary' to stop nuclear threat
